name: graph-first-gate
description: DeepSeek Harness flavour of the same hard gate the pi adapter enforces. v4 inherits the engine fixes that do not depend on harness hooks: the block cap is now a 30-minute sliding window of 200 instead of a lifetime 30, PowerShell/MCP-aware helpers exist in the shared engine, and a bare email is no longer treated as a credential. dsh still has no result hook and no per-turn context injection, so graph_signal_requires_content stays off and the checks that need result/read evidence (think-before-write, no-blind-retry, chg-contract-before-edit) are intentionally NOT enabled here. bash reads remain gated.
